reused_vps_restore_drill.rto_scope: same_vps_isolated_clone_only; excludes WAN transfer, new host provisioning, and DNS cutover

required_owner_inputs.input: Offsite destination inventory & write/readback credentials (/etc/crm-cskh/offsite-backup.env, mode 0600)
required_owner_inputs.details: Destination inventory confirming backup resides outside VPS 103.77.208.186 in an independent failure domain (S3/Object Storage bucket or independent SSH/SFTP host). Note: a different st_dev only proves a different local filesystem, NOT a different physical server or failure domain.

required_owner_inputs.input: Separate secret-vault escrow confirmation for per-bundle backup-key and site encryption_key
required_owner_inputs.details: Secret manager / password vault physically & logically disjoint from both VPS 103.77.208.186 and the offsite archive bucket; record zero-secret receipt via `record-key-escrow`.
